<!--
  THE DASHBOARD FIGURE, AGENT VARIANT — the callback figure frozen at its
  FINAL state, reused to pivot into the agent's point of view.

  This is svg/dashboard.qmd's fully-opened last click, drawn once, at rest.
  Everything the original figure builds across two clicks — the opened chain,
  the fifteen .qmd, the rendered site, the data package — is present from the
  first frame. There is exactly ONE fragment, and it does not add or move any
  ink: click 1 drops a highlight ring around the LLM agent, because the next
  few slides are told from the agent's side and the eye needs to be parked on
  it. Nothing else animates.

  WHY THE COORDINATES DIFFER FROM dashboard.qmd. There the boxes sit at CLOSED
  positions and `.openleft` / `.openright` CSS transforms slide them apart on
  click 1. Here there is no opening to animate, so every coordinate is baked at
  its OPENED home directly: the openleft group is drawn 140 left of here, so
  `me` is at 200 (was 340) and the agent at 400 (was 540); the openright group
  is drawn 140 right, so the window is at 950 (was 810) and its label centred at
  1007 (was 867). The stack, both inner arrows, the render arrow and the data
  package were already at final coordinates in the original and are copied
  verbatim. The direct agent -> site arrow is GONE: it only ever existed to fade
  out as the chain opened, and the chain is already open.

  viewBox "185 68 935 342" is dashboard.qmd's, unchanged, so the two figures
  frame identically and the callback survives — this reads as the same picture,
  held still. The highlight ring (x 390..590, y 133..217) sits well inside it.

  Marker id `ahDashA` is unique to THIS slide. reveal display:none's the
  non-current slides, and a `url(#id)` marker reference resolves to the first
  matching id in the whole document, so the two dashboard figures must not share
  one — dashboard.qmd keeps `ahDash`, this keeps `ahDashA`.

  Palette rule holds: yellow only as the data box's and the content band's FILL,
  never as a line or letter; text on yellow is navy. The highlight ring is red
  `#d1495b` — it appears nowhere else in this figure, so it reads purely as
  emphasis. It is one line to recolour.
-->

```{=html}
<svg viewBox="185 68 935 342" width="100%" style="max-height:85vh;"
     xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     font-family="'Fira Sans Condensed', Tahoma, sans-serif">

  <defs>
    <marker id="ahDashA" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="5.5" refY="3"
            orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L7,3 L0,6 z" fill="#2e4057"/></marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ── me -> agent, opened. `me` at 200, agent at 400 (dashed, unchanged). ── -->
  <rect x="200" y="143" width="110" height="64" rx="6"
        fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="255" y="184" font-size="24" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e4057">me</text>

  <path d="M 312 175 L 392 175" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"
        marker-end="url(#ahDashA)"/>

  <rect x="400" y="143" width="180" height="64" rx="6"
        fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"
        stroke-dasharray="7 5"/>
  <text x="490" y="184" font-size="24" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e4057">LLM agent</text>

  <!-- ── CLICK 1: highlight the agent. A ring around the box, nothing else. ──
       Drawn after the box so the stroke rides on top; fill:none so it never
       tints the label. -->
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1">
    <rect x="390" y="133" width="200" height="84" rx="12"
          fill="none" stroke="#d1495b" stroke-width="6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ── writes -> the .qmd stack, flush right at 860 (final coordinates). ── -->
  <text x="622" y="161" font-size="20" fill="#2e4057"
        text-anchor="middle">writes</text>
  <path d="M 582 175 L 662 175" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"
        marker-end="url(#ahDashA)"/>

  <text x="765" y="90" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#2e4057" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.qmd &#215; 15</text>

  <rect x="686" y="97" width="174" height="124" rx="6"
        fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <rect x="678" y="105" width="182" height="124" rx="6"
        fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <!-- Front card: figure 2's .qmd, same box, same two bands. -->
  <rect x="670" y="113" width="190" height="124" rx="6"
        fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <rect x="686" y="129" width="158" height="36" fill="#00798c"/>
  <text x="765" y="154" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">yaml</text>
  <rect x="686" y="177" width="158" height="44" fill="#edae49"/>
  <text x="765" y="206" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#2e4057" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">content</text>

  <text x="902" y="161" font-size="20" fill="#2e4057"
        text-anchor="middle">render</text>
  <path d="M 862 175 L 942 175" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"
        marker-end="url(#ahDashA)"/>

  <!-- ── The site, opened. Window at 950, label centred on it at 1007. ──────── -->
  <text x="1007" y="98" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#2e4057" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">vehicletrends.us</text>

  <rect x="950" y="110" width="115" height="130" rx="6"
        fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <path d="M 950 132 L 1065 132" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="962" cy="121" r="3" fill="#2e4057"/>
  <circle cx="973" cy="121" r="3" fill="#2e4057"/>
  <circle cx="984" cy="121" r="3" fill="#2e4057"/>

  <path d="M 984 132 L 984 240" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="956" y="144" width="20" height="5" fill="#2e4057"/>
  <rect x="956" y="157" width="20" height="5" fill="#2e4057"/>
  <rect x="956" y="170" width="20" height="5" fill="#2e4057"/>
  <rect x="956" y="183" width="20" height="5" fill="#2e4057"/>

  <rect x="992" y="140" width="64" height="10" fill="#00798c"/>
  <rect x="992" y="154" width="64" height="14" fill="#edae49"/>
  <rect x="992" y="172" width="64" height="8"  fill="#00798c"/>
  <rect x="992" y="184" width="64" height="16" fill="#edae49"/>
  <rect x="992" y="204" width="64" height="10" fill="#00798c"/>
  <rect x="992" y="218" width="64" height="8"  fill="#edae49"/>

  <!-- ── The data package feeding the stack at render (final coordinates). ──── -->
  <path d="M 765 330 L 765 250" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"
        marker-end="url(#ahDashA)"/>
  <rect x="670" y="332" width="190" height="64" rx="6"
        fill="#edae49" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="765" y="356" font-size="19" text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#2e4057" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">{vehicletrends}</text>
  <text x="765" y="380" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#2e4057">R data package</text>

</svg>
```
